rows.new_component_justification: Existing project autoload diagnostic adapter observes runtime state and forwards normal Godot input events to existing UI and V075 Runtime consumers; it does not directly mutate gameplay authority. Its request/event cursor and wall-clock polling are diagnostic state, not gameplay identity or Kernel tick/RNG/replay state. It remains reachable in the development production scene and disabled by the existing space_syndicate_release feature guard.
